verdict.rationale: Trilegal's IP page lists trade secrets and confidential information among its advisory areas and names trade secrets among its high-stakes litigation subjects. A Labour and Employment deal (a CTO/co-founder exit that protected 'highly critical intellectual property and proprietary information') touches employee mobility. The evidence is mostly generic practice-area listing, with no specific trade-secret matter or confidentiality-program engagement documented. Missing for 10: a concrete trade-secret litigation matter or outcome, documented confidentiality-program or trade-secret audit work, employee-mobility disputes (non-competes, poaching or injunctions) as opposed to a negotiated exit, and any independent corroboration or rankings for trade-secret work.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: Our team advises on the full spectrum of IP, including trademarks, copyrights, patents, designs, trade secrets, and confidential information
Representing clients in high-stakes litigation involving patents, trademarks, copyrights, design rights, trade secrets
without compromising on its highly critical intellectual property and proprietary information
